name: cbu_documents
description: Search California Baptist University's own documents -- degree programs and their year-by-year course plans, general education and non-course requirements, transfer and AP credit policies, department policies like variances, and CSDS/engineering material. This is the ONLY acceptable source for any factual claim about CBU: courses, units, requirements, deadlines, names, policies. Call it before answering any CBU question, and if it comes back with nothing, say you do not have that rather than answering from memory.

question.description: The question to look up, phrased as the student asked it. Keep campus terms like BASAI, MSAI, CSDS and course codes intact -- they are what the search matches on.
